scope: Four gentle shared interaction sounds: pickup, placement, your turn, final scores. Ambience untouched.
status: Four single successful takes downloaded, decoded, filtered and level checked; subjective listening acceptance pending.
notes: The provider rejected the first four prompts before producing audio because its prompt maximum is 450 characters; this limit was not included in the returned model schema.

Those explicitly failed sessions were replaced with shortened prompts. One successful take was generated per action. Provider price metadata is recorded for failed and successful sessions; actual billing/refund state was not independently verified.

Original downloaded files are unchanged. Game copies are shortened where appropriate, high-pass and low-pass filtered, and faded at both edges. Encoded MP3 peaks were measured below -18 dBFS. Envelope analysis identified clear action onsets at time zero; a 2ms fade preserves the foley attack. Pickup receives a bounded positive gain after filtering because its measured event is over 15dB above the late tail; no near-silent source or tail is normalized.
No subjective listening or speaker/headphone balance acceptance has been performed. Prompts express intended content, not verified semantic claims.

Second preparation pass reviewed original and filtered envelopes in 5ms, 10ms and 20ms windows. Pickup and place retain their complete early actions; turn and final-scores audio bytes are unchanged from the first preparation pass.
